name: oracle-opportunity-pulse
description: Manage guided Oracle opportunity Pulse setup, normalized SharePoint lists, Markdown evidence, personal automation, and a SharePoint-backed Knowledge Wiki.

interface.shortDescription: Manage Oracle opportunity lists and wiki evidence.
interface.longDescription: Manages guided installation or connection to a shared SharePoint Pulse, normalized Oracle opportunity and knowledge item lists, Markdown evidence from Slack channel links, tagged Outlook messages, Zoom AI Companion transcripts, manual notes, personal daily automation preparation, and a SharePoint-backed Knowledge Wiki index.
defaultPrompt: Use pulse-01-setup to install a new Pulse or connect to an existing one.
Use pulse-02-automation to validate sources and prepare my personal 18:00 daily automation.
Use pulse-01-setup to create the Oracle Opportunity Pulse lists, shared profile, and base folders.
Use pulse-99-test to check that SharePoint, Outlook, and Slack are ready.
Use pulse-05-slack to register this Slack channel for an Oracle opportunity.
Use pulse-07-wiki to query the Oracle Opportunity Pulse Knowledge Wiki.
